description: Crime in Western Australia is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Western Australia Police Force. The Western Australia Police Force provides crime statistics in interactive graphs and tables, and as downloadable tables and reports. Data is provided on offence type and down to the suburb level. Data also available for WA state total and state-defined metropolitan and regional areas. Coverage is the states and territories, 2007 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
